goal: Find the smallest measured setup that completes authorized clean-history updates while preserving remote work and protecting default branches.
regression: All existing and new scenarios, skill condition, two repetitions on each agent as required by repository instructions.
selection: Compare paired scenario outcomes. Prefer a smaller setup if larger setups add no observed safety or completion benefit. Report ties and uncertainty; never call zero observed failures proof of universal safety.
isolation: Disposable local repositories presented through an HTTPS Git helper; stub GitHub commands; isolated Git config and agent instructions; no hosted pushes from evaluations.
compatibility: older Git rejection without config mutation
change_control: Freeze candidate hashes before the primary matrix. Treat later tuning runs as development; rerun any affected final comparisons. Preserve all errors and reruns in the report.
